parameters.query: INSERT INTO crm_leads (email, name, company, intent, priority, lead_score, last_summary, reply_draft) SELECT r->>'email', r->>'name', r->>'company', r->>'intent', r->>'priority', (r->>'lead_score')::int, r->>'summary', r->>'reply_draft' FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS r) AS input ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET intent = EXCLUDED.intent, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, lead_score = EXCLUDED.lead_score, last_summary = EXCLUDED.last_summary, reply_draft = EXCLUDED.reply_draft, updated_at = now() RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify(({ email: $('Parse + validate').item.json.from_email, name: $('Parse + validate').item.json.from_name, company: $('Parse + validate').item.json.classification.company, intent: $('Parse + validate').item.json.classification.intent, priority: $('Parse + validate').item.json.classification.priority, lead_score: $('Parse + validate').item.json.classification.lead_score, summary: $('Parse + validate').item.json.classification.summary, reply_draft: $('Parse + validate').item.json.classification.reply_draft })) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: $('Parse + validate').item.json.subject, requester: $('Parse + validate').item.json.from_email, priority: $('Parse + validate').item.json.classification.priority, description: $('Parse + validate').item.json.notify_text }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO inbox_triage_log (from_email, channel, subject, intent, priority, lead_score, summary, classifier_ok, received_at) SELECT r->>'from_email', r->>'channel', r->>'subject', r->>'intent', r->>'priority', (r->>'lead_score')::int, r->>'summary', (r->>'classifier_ok')::boolean, (r->>'received_at')::timestamptz FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS r) AS input RETURNING id;
